reviews.text: I have awful problems with digestion and upset stomach but this stuff is amazing I don’t much stomach issues as I did before also I found it’s better to pop it into your mouth first and sip a little water with it mix it and swallow it was easier to do it this way I found when it mixes with water in a glass it was clumping
reviews.zh: 我嘅消化同胃部不適問題都好差，但係呢樣嘢好好，我嘅胃部問題冇以前咁多。另外我發現，最好係先放入口，然後啜少少水，撈勻咗再吞落，咁樣做比較易。我發覺放入杯水度攪，佢會結成一嚿。

reviews.text:
I gave it to my friend bc she wanted something that can support her digestive health after being on antibiotics for a while. 

Recently I asked her how she felt nowadays
and she said she feels like her digestion is more or less back
to normal after finishing this box of probiotics. 

Overall, she said she would recommend it to other people too.
reviews.zh:
我將佢送畀我個朋友，因為佢想搵啲可以幫助消化系統健康嘅嘢，佢之前食咗抗生素一段時間。

最近我問佢而家點樣，佢話食完呢盒益生菌之後，消化差不多已經返返正常。

整體嚟講，佢話會推薦畀其他人。

reviews.text:
I haven’t had many sticks of this goat milk colostrum protein probiotic yet, but so far, it seems pretty great! It looks clean, high-quality, and definitely leans toward the healthy side. I actually bought it after reading up on all the benefits of goat milk and colostrum, and this one combines those with added probiotics, which is a big plus.

What’s funny is—even the doctor who saw it said it looked too good to open, like it’s something you'd want to save! That gave me a good laugh but also made me feel like I made a solid choice.

The packaging is very convenient—small sticks that are easy to carry or throw in a bag for travel. I like that it doesn’t come in a big bulky tub. It makes portioning simple, especially for someone like me who sometimes forgets to take supplements.

Overall, it gives a good impression—healthy, thoughtfully made, and gentle on the stomach. I’m planning to start drinking it regularly and see how it helps with digestion and overall energy. So far, so good!
reviews.zh:
我仲未食過好多包呢款羊奶初乳蛋白益生菌，但係到目前為止，感覺都幾好！佢睇落好乾淨、高質，絕對偏向健康方向。我係睇咗羊奶同初乳嘅好處之後先買嘅，而呢款將呢啲同加咗嘅益生菌結合埋一齊，係一個好大嘅優點。

好笑嘅係——連睇過佢嘅醫生都話，佢睇落太靚，好似唔捨得打開咁，好似要留住咁！咁樣令我笑咗一陣，但都令我覺得自己揀啱咗。

包裝好方便——細細包，易攜帶，或者放入袋帶去旅行都得。我鍾意佢唔係大大嚿嘅罐裝。咁樣分份好簡單，尤其係對我呢啲有時會忘記食補充劑嘅人嚟講。

整體嚟講，印象都好好——健康、用心製造，而且對胃溫和。我打算開始定期飲，睇吓對消化同整體精力有咩幫助。到目前為止都幾好！

reviews.text: Este producto es excelente, te regula el estomago por lo que puedes ir al baño tranquila, en mi caso yo sufro de estreñimiento y me ayudado a corregir esto. Aparte que te ayuda a desinflamar la parte del abdomen. Lo recomiendo al 100%. En mi caso yo lo tomo todas las mañanas.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品好好，幫你調理腸胃，所以你可以安心去廁所。就我個人嚟講，我有便秘問題，而佢幫我改善咗。另外亦幫助減輕腹部嘅脹。我百分百推薦。我係每朝都食。

reviews.text: I’ve been using colostrum powder for a while now, and I’m really impressed with its quality. The texture is fine and smooth, making it easy to mix into liquids or simply let dissolve in the mouth. It has a lightly sweet taste that’s pleasant and not overpowering. I also appreciate how easily it dissolves, making it convenient to take.
reviews.zh: 我用咗初乳粉一段時間，對佢嘅質素真係好欣賞。質地幼滑細緻，容易攪入飲品，或者直接含喺口入面溶化都得。味道微甜，好舒服，唔會好濃。我亦都欣賞佢溶解得好快，令食用更加方便。

reviews.text: I haven´t used this long enought to tell if it has health benefits, but i really don’t like the flavor. I thought it might taste a bit like citrus since has a sublet citrus scent. However the flavor is really bad, i tried mixing it with some kombucha I had and that helped. So i would recommend mixing it with some kind of juice.
reviews.zh: 我用得未夠耐，所以未能判斷有冇健康效益，但係我真係唔鍾意個味道。我以為味道會有啲似柑橘，因為有少少柑橘香味。不過味道真係好差，我試過用手上嘅康普茶攪埋一齊飲，就好啲。所以我建議你用某啲果汁攪埋飲。

reviews.text: Lo llevo probando 15 días y para ser sincera si ayuda con el tema de la digestión, lo que más me gusta es que no es agresivo por lo que prácticamente puedes comer y sentirte tranquila (osea me refiero a que no lo piensas dos veces en tomarlo por el tema del baño), en mi caso me a ayudado bastante a regular mi estómago y también siento que me ayudo con el tema del apetito. Igual pienso darle más tiempo para volver con una reseña mas completa. El sabor es como leche en polvo pero de vainilla muy rico, por último yo lo tomo todas las mañanas (por fas ayúdame con una manita arriba 👍, gracias🫰)
reviews.zh: 我已經試咗 15 日，老實講，佢確實有助消化。我最鍾意嘅係佢唔會太猛烈，所以基本上你食完都可以好安心（即係話，唔使因為上廁所嘅問題而諗兩次先食）。以我嚟講，佢幫我好好調節咗腸胃，我亦都覺得幫到我嘅食慾。我打算再俾多啲時間，之後再寫一個更完整嘅評論。味道似雲呢拿味嘅奶粉，好好味，最後，我每朝都會食 （拜託幫我撳個讚 👍，多謝🫰）

reviews.text: The little portions are very easy to swallow, it really is a very fine powder but it melts fast when I take it without water, it tastes like powdered biscuits, just a little sweat, I feel like after just three days my stomach is less bothered by greasy or fat food, and my bowel movements are more supple as well.
reviews.zh: 每小份好容易吞，佢真係好幼嘅粉，但係唔用水食嘅時候好快溶，味道似粉狀餅乾，少少甜。我覺得只係用咗三日，我嘅胃就冇咁介意油膩或者肥膩嘅食物，而且排便都變得更順暢。
